_source.title: 打开工程
_source.remarks.text.0: 本操作将会在 EDA 前端打开指定工程，如若原先已打开其它工程且有未保存的变更，执行本操作将直接丢失所有未保存的数据

title: Open project
remarks.text.0: This operation will open the specified project in the EDA front end. If another project was previously opened with unsaved changes, executing this operation will directly lose all unsaved data
